rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a poor-quality early blastocyst consistent with 1DD and appropriately notes absent/degenerative ICM and TE; cautious about limits of a still image, though zona and finer structural details are not described.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, prior IVF history, prior live birth, endometrial thickness, diagnosis, partner age, and sperm parameters with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to morphology and clinical history; minor issue is some ambiguity around calling this a Day 4 blastocyst versus standard blast timing.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading interpretation and evidence-based IVF counseling, including single embryo transfer and consideration of uterine evaluation/PGT-A; slight overreach in some adjunct suggestions and strong alcohol advice.
Provides clear practical recommendations for current transfer management and structured future planning, including uterine assessment, embryo strategy, male-factor review, and lifestyle optimization.
